Apple (AAPL) Position Maintained by Anchor Capital Advisors Llc; Pfizer (PFE) Shareholder Vantage Investment Advisors Cut Stake as Stock Price Declined
June 12, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Vantage Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Pfizer (PFE) by 6.87% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vantage Investment Advisors Llc sold 11,135 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.80% with the market. The institutional investor held 151,013 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.36M, down from 162,148 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vantage Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Pfizer for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $212.34 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.01% or $0.37 during the last trading session, reaching $36.3. About 18.51M shares traded. Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) has risen 10.95% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.62% the S&P500.
